# Smiles By Jiveh

> Dental practice of Dr. Jiveh in Royal Palm Beach, Florida: general, cosmetic and reconstructive dentistry, including dental implants, All-on-X full arch restoration, veneers, Invisalign, crowns, dentures, sedation and TMJ treatment. 11989 Southern Blvd, Royal Palm Beach, FL. Phone (561) 798-9997.
